messages:
Kesha Thomas: quick sync — planning DP recruitment & feedback handoff for the low-latency embeddings pilot. timeline: 6 weeks. need: 12 partners, 3 early integrations, acceptance criteria, NDA flow. thoughts?
Malik Chen: 12 partners sounds right. recommend 6 core + 6 overflow. core = teams with high embed QPS. overlap with existing DP list?
Eva Rios: we should gate on real query distribution (>=100k embed/day) and latency requirement <50ms p95. otherwise results won't stress batching.
Oliver Patel: agree. also add device/region variety. can we reuse the eval harness to measure regression on our canonical prompts? cc @product-bot
product-bot: checklist created: 1) intake form 2) NDA template 3) onboarding runbook 4) eval harness link 5) rollout canary policy — https://redwood-internal/pilot/checklist
Maria Gomez: legal flagged one clause in NDA about logging — we need opt-out for telemetry in private deployments. i'll post redline by EOD.
Kesha Thomas: good call. Malik/Eva — can one of you draft a 6-question screener? keep it lightweight. suggested fields: workloads, QPS, data sensitivity, infra (VPC/on-prem), infra contact, success metrics.
Malik Chen: draft below:
```
1) Primary use case & expected monthly embed calls
2) Typical request sizes and average tokens
3) 95th latency target
4) Privacy/regulatory constraints
5) Preferred deployment (hosted/dedicated/private)
6) Define success (business metric)
```
Eva Rios: add 'existing model or embeddings pipeline' and 'can provide sample traffic for 2 weeks'
Kesha Thomas: perfect. next: feedback loop — we want weekly 30m sync + shared Notion w/ prioritized issues + monthly quality report. early regressions auto-flag via eval harness.
Oliver Patel: propose we assign a CS lead for each partner and a single eng contact for rollouts. reduces hopping.
Maria Gomez: redlines posted: https://redwood-internal/legal/nda-redline — recommend opt-out telemetry + explicit retention period. cc @Kesha Thomas
Kesha Thomas: thanks all. action items: Malik finalize screener by noon, Oliver map eng contacts, Maria finalize NDA, product-bot to create intake form + Notion page. we'll reconvene Thurs 11am for gating review. :rocket:
